dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is defying expectations and leaving XRP in the dust! 🚀 With a staggering 14% price surge, it now holds the title of the 7th largest crypto by market cap. Is this just the beginning? As more investors embrace meme tokens, we may witness a shift in the crypto landscape.

Cryptocurrencies aren't just for enthusiasts anymore; they're becoming a strategic business play! 🌐 Neptune Digital Assets is diving into 1M Dogecoin while also boosting its Bitcoin stash. As Dogecoin's volatility swings, could we see it rebound with ETF interest on the rise?
